blocks.text: BEIJING, China – China’s Foreign Minister Wang Yi and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio held a phone call on Thursday, Chinese state media said, days before an expected meeting between their two countries’ leaders. President Donald Trump is expected to host Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping at the White House next week to discuss a host of issues including trade, artificial intelligence and the US-Iran war. In the call with Rubio, Wang said that China and the United States “should prepare for next stage of high-level exchanges in spirit of equality, mutual respect, mutual benefit”, state news agency Xinhua reported.
